A.reason: Fixed five-section arc with claim-ish H3s under results (54, 75, 79); no H1, no skipped levels, $$ only, real table, front matter complete (subtitle, paper_author, paper_doi, two-level categories, use_math). Top-level headings are topic names ('연구 배경', '제안 방법'), standard for the summary template.

D.reason: Hard parts get help where they appear: zero-init intuition (34), GPT-3 scale arithmetic 12,288^2 vs 98,304 (38), '핵심' box contrasting serial adapters with parallel mergeable path (42), and the projection-norm triple 0.32/21.67/0.02 that makes the amplification claim readable (83). E.reason: Architecture figure placed with the formula (36), scatter placed with the scaling discussion (71), Table 4 copied cell for cell with one header row (58-67), referred to descriptively. Minor: ablation numbers at 81 would fit a small table.

F.reason: All 20 checked claims supported, tables cell-exact. G.reason: use_math true with $$ in body; description 138 chars, opens with 'LoRA', numbers (10,000배, 3배) from TL;DR and the paper; no Liquid, no pipes in math in tables. Lint not run (read-only judge).

X1.reason: Category 'Finetuning' fits. Tags line 10 mostly restate abstract phrases rather than reusable tags: 'Rank-Decomposition-Matrices', 'Frozen-Pre-trained-Weights', 'Adapter-Inference-Latency' (a baseline problem, not a technique LoRA uses); 'Parameter-Efficient-Fine-Tuning' + 'Low-Rank-Adaptation' are the useful ones.

U1.reason: All five questions covered: motivation with latency and few-shot numbers (20-22), solution (26-42), implementation incl. target matrices, |Theta|, memory, hyperparameters (46-50), results across GPT-3/DeBERTa/RoBERTa/GPT-2 and ablations (54-83), significance and limits (87-89).

U2.reason: About 5.3k prose chars, readable in ~5-6 minutes; TL;DR three plain sentences, no math (16); one distilled results table; grounded limitations (89: batching merged weights, attention-only scope, small r not universal). Slightly number-heavy in 48 and 77.

C.reason: Line 74 '이 구성으로 WikiSQL 73.8, MNLI-m 91.6' has no antecedent in its section and repeats line 44's numbers; line 44 drops a result into the hypothesis subsection before any experimental setup; line 72 restates TL;DR.

checklist.details: human_fixes.yaml lists no item-specific fixes (fixes: []). The notes' generic defects were checked anyway: no '&' leak, title is the paper title -> both avoided.

top_issues: Insufficient coverage: no memory/checkpoint savings, adapter latency numbers or smaller-model (RoBERTa/DeBERTa/GPT-2) results; line 72 asserts four-model parity without numbers.
Flow and repetition: '이 구성으로' (74) has no antecedent and repeats 73.8/91.6 from 44; '구현 방식' holds ablations; unmarked positional-embedding mechanism at 24.

preference.reason: Both are factually clean, but X covers the whole paper (latency, memory, all four model families, ablations, subspace analysis) with grounded numbers and a verbatim main table, while Y omits memory and smaller-model results, repeats the same 73.8/91.6 result with a dangling reference, mislabels its implementation section and adds one unmarked mechanism. Y's closing judgment (99) is the better-written personal assessment, which is its one clear edge.
